newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila bourse suspends erring broker.
newsitem.headline: Manila bourse suspends erring broker.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) said on Thursday it decided to suspend a broker accused by a newspaper columnist of using her account without authority.

"The PSE has concluded an investigation of the case of Ninez Cacho Olivarez and we are suspending Jose Maximo Cuaycong from any trading with any member broker of the PSE," PSE president Jose Luis Yulo told reporters.

Olivarez said Cuaycong had used four firms, Abacus Securities Corp, Dharmala Securities Phils Inc, Lippo Securities and Sapphire Securities, for his transactions. The four firms have denied any wrongdoing.

The four brokers "may have committed administrative and procedural lapses and certain violations of the Revised Securities Act and/or existing Securities and Exchange Commission rules, which are however not fraudelent acts," the bourse said in a statement. It did not elaborate.
Yulo said the stock exchange turned over findings of the inquiry to the SEC which started its own investigation.
"We will coordinate with them on further actions required," Yulo said.
